Any uncompensated costs, extra risk premium, delay or impairment larger than that reverses acceptance. Historic933bps (9.33%) is not a future quote; real rate must be read at origination.

alternative_branch.preferred_route_under_present_assumption: Direct sponsor advance or customer prepayment, if available with equivalent acceptable settlement and protections. Do not force pool credit.
alternative_branch.why_direct_dominates_in_base_case: Sponsor already owns100 and accepts its principal default risk by staking. It can instead advance that same100 directly, avoid locking separate125 lender capital, and keep the same success-contingent3 fee. With identical0.50 gas and no incremental enforcement/service fee, borrower retains0.178931 more, while no additional lender is necessary. A repayment history/0.080518 reserve balance is a protocol benefit, not evidence that the extra capital use improves participant economics.
alternative_branch.not_absolute_dominance: Pool might supply genuinely valued standardized custody, permissioned underwriting operations, accounting, enforceable sponsor commitments, diversification/access to future funding or lower total costs. Direct repayment enforcement and fees may differ. Price and verify those benefits; do not invent them.
pool_route_acceptance_requirements: Sponsor explicitly confirms why risk-budget stake is available while direct lending is operationally unavailable or inferior; merely asserting unwillingness is insufficient.
At least one verified pool benefit exceeds incremental0.178931 borrower financing cost plus opportunity of extra125 lender capital and deployment/security costs.
Customer prepayment or milestone alternative also compared and rejected on documented grounds.
CI30 fix deployed/reviewed before public mainnet funding.
